verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed that a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable at docs.cekura.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). The docs also include API reference pages (e.g., send-calls and create-api-key) that appear to be backed by that spec. Missing for 10: first-party documentation pointing users to the spec download, and evidence that the spec covers all endpoints and is versioned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.cekura.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Create a new API key. When using API key authentication, only project-level API keys can be created.
